parameters.name: AccessRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region that accesses the PrivateZone service.

The access region is the region from which the PrivateZone service is accessed.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: HostRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service is deployed.

parameters.name: HostVpcId
parameters.description: The VPC-connected instance ID associated with the PrivateZone service.
